en: Colorized panoramic postcard view of a hillside spa town with richly ornamented multi‑story buildings in historicist style. A row of grand townhouses and hotels lines a street in the foreground, while larger villas and mansions are scattered up the green hillside, with a forested hill in the background. A smoking red chimney rises from one of the foreground buildings. Printed captions in German appear at the top, identifying the town and specific streets.
